test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There are many plants and animals that cannot ______ in very cold or very hot places.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**survive**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Survive** means **continuing to exist**.

 
 
• Example - ***Rats can survive in the wild***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence is, **There are many plants and animals that cannot survive in very cold or very hot places.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Preserve** means **to protect or to look after**.

 
 
• Example - ***Shane preserves his family's legacy in his house***.
 
 
 
• **Tolerates** means **to endure or to bear**.
 
 
• Example - ***Sammy will not tolerate your continuous inferior quality of work.***
 
 
 
• **Bear **means** to put up with**.
 
 
• Example -*** I will not bear with this anymore***.
